explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full microsoft-privacy system, prioritizing the primary settings/privacy flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The Microsoft privacy dashboard has functional deletion/clear workflows and download-data interactions, but many 'Manage activity' links (e.g., search, location, voice) are non-functional (href='#'), and ad-settings toggle interactions failed. Mobile view has small tap targets, and 19% of features remain untested (e.g., ad topic toggles, product-level privacy links).

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Microsoft privacy system, covering primary settings, activity management, and ad settings, with checks for responsiveness, state changes, and error handling.
exploration_plan.summary: Start with the main dashboard (index.html), validate activity cards and privacy toggles. Then explore browse-history.html for filtering and deletion. Next, check ad-settings.html for toggle interactions. Finally, verify download-data.html and repeat key checks in mobile view. Ensure all pages and critical controls are exercised.
assumptions: All pages load without errors (prescan shows no load errors)
Interactive elements (toggles, buttons, links) function as expected
Mobile viewport has responsive layout adjustments
risk_hotspots: Modal dialogs (clear data, download confirmation) for proper dismissal
Toggle switches (ad settings, privacy toggles) for state persistence
Small tap targets (top navigation links) in mobile view

phases.title: Main Dashboard (index.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate activity cards, privacy toggles, and top navigation
key_checks: Click 'Manage browse activity' to ensure navigation to browse-history.html works
Interact with a privacy toggle (e.g., 'Voice activity') to check 'Saving…/Saved' feedback
Verify top navigation links (e.g., 'Privacy', 'Security') load correct pages
Check 'Download your data' link navigates to download-data.html
exit_criteria: All activity cards and privacy toggles interacted with, navigation links verified

phases.title: Browse History (browse-history.html) Management
phases.objective: Test filtering, deletion, and empty state
key_checks: Use 'Time range' and 'Device' filters to verify activity table updates
Delete a single activity row and check animation/state change
Click 'Clear all' to trigger modal, dismiss modal and confirm cancellation
Trigger empty state (e.g., delete all entries) and verify message
exit_criteria: Filtering, single delete, bulk delete (with modal), and empty state verified

phases.title: Ad Settings (ad-settings.html) Toggles
phases.objective: Validate master and per-service toggle interactions
key_checks: Toggle 'See ads that interest you' master switch and check sub-toggles update
Toggle a per-service switch (e.g., 'Microsoft consumer apps') and verify state
Check 'Manage LinkedIn ad preferences' link navigates correctly
Verify ad topic toggles (e.g., 'Technology News') work
exit_criteria: Master and per-service toggles interacted with, ad topic toggles verified

phases.title: Download Data (download-data.html) Configuration
phases.objective: Test data selection and confirmation flow
key_checks: Select/deselect data categories (e.g., 'Account profile', 'Browse activity')
Proceed through 'Time range' and 'How to deliver it' steps
Trigger download confirmation modal and dismiss it
Verify 'privacy dashboard' link navigates back to index.html
exit_criteria: Data categories selected, download flow (up to modal) verified

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks in mobile view
key_checks: Check top navigation links for improved tap targets in mobile view
Re-interact with a privacy toggle and ad toggle in mobile view
Test 'Manage browse activity' navigation in mobile view
Verify modal dialogs (e.g., 'Clear all') are accessible in mobile
exit_criteria: Critical checks repeated in mobile view, responsive issues (e.g., tap targets) noted

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, browse-history, ad-settings, download-data)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible toggles, buttons, filters, and modal dialogs
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat at least 3 critical checks (e.g., toggle, navigation, modal) in mobile viewport

notes: Pay attention to 'Saving…/Saved' feedback for toggles, ensure modals close properly, and document any layout warnings (e.g., small tap targets)

findings.user_goal: Manage activity data (e.g., search, location, voice) via 'Manage' links
findings.problem: Multiple 'Manage activity' links (e.g., 'Manage search activity', 'Manage location activity', 'Manage voice activity') use href='#' and do not navigate to new pages or show feedback, indicating broken navigation.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Manage search activity' (ux-19) added '#' to URL; 'Manage location activity' (ux-20) and 'Manage voice activity' (ux-21) had no URL/UI change. DOM shows href='#' for these links.
findings.why_it_matters: Users cannot access activity management pages, blocking goal completion for reviewing/clearing activity data.
findings.suggestion: Update hrefs to valid activity pages (e.g., 'search-history.html') or add modals/feedback for in-place management.

findings.user_goal: Interact with ad-settings master toggle and sub-toggles
findings.problem: Ad-settings master toggle ('See ads that interest you') and 'LinkedIn' sub-toggle clicks failed (timeout), preventing state change testing.
findings.evidence: Click actions on ux-85 (master toggle) and ux-86 (LinkedIn toggle) timed out; no state change or feedback observed.
findings.why_it_matters: Users cannot adjust ad preferences, blocking customization of ad targeting.
findings.suggestion: Fix toggle interactivity (e.g., ensure JavaScript binds click events, resolve DOM timing issues).

findings.problem: Mobile view has small tap targets (e.g., 'Microsoft' link 58x19px, 'Manage browse activity' 172x26px) below 44px guidance, reducing accessibility.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings show multiple links/buttons with height <44px; e.g., 'Microsoft' link bbox height 19px.
findings.why_it_matters: Small targets increase tap errors, harming mobile usability (especially for motor-impaired users).
findings.suggestion: Increase tap target size (e.g., min-height 44px) via CSS for mobile view.

findings.user_goal: Download data with specific categories/time range
findings.problem: Download-data dropdowns (e.g., 'Archive format', 'Time range', 'Email') failed to expand on click, blocking format/ delivery customization.
findings.evidence: Clicking 'Archive format' (ux-29) and 'Time range' (ux-27) dropdowns showed no expansion; 'Email' dropdown had no feedback.
findings.why_it_matters: Users cannot specify data format/delivery, blocking complete download configuration.
findings.suggestion: Fix dropdown interactivity (e.g., ensure CSS display: none/block toggles, resolve JavaScript issues).

findings.user_goal: Explore all privacy features (e.g., ad topics, product privacy links)
findings.problem: Only 19% of interactive features were tested; untested features include ad topic toggles, product-level privacy links (e.g., Windows, Xbox), and 'About our ads' links.
findings.evidence: Coverage report shows 128 observed features, 24 exercised; untested features include ad topic checkboxes, product privacy links (e.g., 'Windows' href='#').
findings.why_it_matters: Untested features may have UX issues (e.g., broken links, unclear feedback) unaddressed.
findings.suggestion: Expand testing to untested features (e.g., ad topic toggles, product privacy links) to identify gaps.

findings.user_goal: Navigate to product-level privacy pages (e.g., Windows, Xbox)
findings.problem: Product-level privacy links (e.g., 'Windows', 'Xbox') use href='#' and do not navigate, blocking access to product-specific settings.
findings.evidence: DOM shows 'Windows' (ux-28) and 'Xbox' (ux-29) links with href='#'; no navigation on click.
findings.why_it_matters: Users cannot access product-specific privacy controls, limiting customization.
findings.suggestion: Update hrefs to valid product privacy pages (e.g., 'windows-privacy.html') or add in-page content.

findings.problem: While 'Clear all' triggers a confirmation modal, the 'Manage search activity' link’s failure to navigate creates confusion about activity management.
findings.evidence: 'Clear all' modal works, but 'Manage search activity' (ux-19) is non-functional, creating inconsistency in activity management workflows.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent functionality (some actions work, others don’t) erodes trust and increases user frustration.
findings.suggestion: Align all 'Manage' links to functional pages/modals, or remove non-functional links to avoid confusion.

gaps: Only directly exercised 19% of visible interactive feature signatures.
8 browser action(s) failed and should be retried or analyzed.
44% of actions produced no visible URL/text change; this may indicate dead controls or repeated probes.
